question:

solution:
The figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4fad7dc6b163dddaaa028a27ae0d79f394cfb388101dfdc64c9e9e53493d3485.png]
